prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A highly detailed, cinematic scene set inside a retro-futuristic fast food restaurant, inspired by classic American diners but with a playful sci-fi twist. The main subjects are two iconic Star Wars characters: Darth Vader and a Stormtrooper, both in full, highly accurate costumes. Darth Vader stands at the counter, holding a tray of fried food, his imposing black armor and cape contrasting sharply with the warm, inviting tones of the restaurant. The Stormtrooper stands just behind him, also holding a tray, their white armor gleaming under the bright, even lighting.

The counter is lined with plates of golden fried chicken and other comfort foods, displayed behind a glass case. Above the counter, illuminated neon signs read "FRIED BUZZ" and "FRIED WOMPA," adding a whimsical, otherworldly touch. The menu boards feature colorful, cartoonish illustrations of food items with playful sci-fi names, further blending the Star Wars universe with the diner aesthetic.

The background features warm, orange and brown tones, with metallic and textured surfaces that evoke both a cozy diner and a spaceship interior. The floor has a unique, dimpled metallic pattern, enhancing the futuristic vibe. The lighting is bright and evenly distributed, creating a cheerful, inviting atmosphere. The overall composition is balanced, with the characters centered and the counter leading the viewer’s eye into the scene. The style is hyper-realistic with a touch of humor, capturing both the grandeur of the Star Wars universe and the everyday charm of a fast food restaurant.
